verdict.rationale: Caveman ships a response skill and loads plugins from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, so a skill-authoring workflow is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows no spec, template, or meta-skill that would let an agent author and package a new skill end to end. Running existing plugins and the community's mention of the packaged caveman.skill file are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill
